related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve how effectively MNCS language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents through evidence from real development.

outcome.implementation_condition: Correction validation required a selected-page registration status even when the bounded read-only workspace lookup had independently verified the exact source blob and digest.
outcome.interpretation: The projection conflated page-local evidence registration with source content integrity. This prevented an append-only owner-audit correction from contributing its verified P-001 pointer to native-capability accountability.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Page-local evidence registration can mask independently verified correction sources
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment campaign correction validation and capability-accountability projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authenticated page-zero projection rejected one correction while its P-001 replacement source was independently digest-verified from a read-only workspace checkout and explicitly reported absent only from the selected campaign evidence page.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Keep page-local registration separate from content integrity: allow a non-observation replacement source when its exact blob is independently verified through bounded read-only workspace access, while preserving both statuses in the projection.
not_measured: how often other append-only corrections use sources absent from their selected campaign pages
whether an agent relied on the rejected correction or missing accountability link
whether this behavior occurs in other projection or repository workflows
cross-session recurrence or long-term improvement effectiveness

measurement_limits: The baseline is one authenticated campaign page and one exact correction record; recurrence is not established.

The projection rejection status alone did not identify which replacement validation predicate failed; the predicate mismatch was established by inspecting the implementation and reproduced with a focused regression test.
The pressure concerns evidence eligibility and projection traceability; it does not establish causality, agent impact, or native migration readiness.
